Summarize the following quarterly report in exactly 4 bullet points, no preamble:

Executive summary: quarterly performance shows throughput improved across all regions while unit economics held steady. Opex increased modestly due to infrastructure scaling ahead of demand growth. Regional breakdown: APAC led growth at 23% QoQ, EMEA held at 11%, and Americas contributed 8%. Currency headwinds in EMEA offset part of the volume gain. LatAm remains a small but fast-growing base. Product line: the platform tier drove 61% of new ARR. Legacy on-prem renewals declined 14% as migration incentives took effect. Add-on modules saw the highest expansion revenue per account. Infrastructure: compute spend grew 19% against 31% growth in served tokens, indicating improving unit cost. Storage tiering recovered an estimated 7% of egress. Reliability SLOs met except for a single SEV-2 during the mid-quarter deploy. Risk register: concentration risk in two hyperscale accounts; mitigation is pipeline diversification. Supply-chain exposure to GPU allocation is hedged via multi-quarter reservations. Regulatory: data-residency rollout on track for the EMEA target date. Outlook: guidance raised to reflect the APAC momentum, tempered by the Americas renewal cycle. Hiring plan holds flat; capital allocation prioritizes inference efficiency work this half.
